mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts signals weakening consumer demand for durable goods, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:late-cycle expansion defined by GDP growth > 2% and unemployment < 4%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production over the past month indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with declining INDPRO, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5% in a 3-month window, it signals an overheating labor market that may trigger aggressive Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales and housing starts signals robust consumer and housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and rising HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 250), the S&P 500 tends to have positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in potential Fed rate cuts.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
